purpose: Documents allowed to state a past chain state, with the reason. tools/check-state-drift.mjs fails on any other disagreement between a claim and a live read. Use rule "*" to exempt a whole file; prefer a per-rule entry. A single stale line can also opt out inline with a `state-claim: historical` comment, which is the better choice when only one sentence is historical.

allow.reason: A dated record of what the deployment produced on 2026-08-01. It describes the chain at that moment by definition, and rewriting it as the chain moves would destroy the evidence it exists to preserve.
A signed statement recorded on 2026-07-29. Its wording is the artifact; it must not be edited to track later state.
The requirements as recorded on 2026-08-01, superseded in part by a header note rather than rewritten, so the original plan stays readable.
